proposed.text: A designer proposes a 1:6 window-to-floor ratio on a west-facing facade in the Philippines. What is the primary design concern?

options.text: Reduction in structural rigidity, which may compromise the building's ability to withstand lateral forces.
Increased structural load, potentially requiring additional reinforcement in the facade design.
Excessive afternoon solar heat gain and glare.
Violation of the maximum WFR in PD 1096, which could lead to non-compliance with local building regulations.

proposed.rationale: PD 1096 Section 808 supports the 10% window-opening minimum. The 2.5x daylight-depth rule and tropical facade orientation are design heuristics; use them only when the question frames them as design guidance rather than code.
